sections.title: Astarion peruses his written insights about sundry creatures of the night.
Revelers at this decadent ball in Baldur's Gate don't realize that vampires are in their midst and on the prowl
An exasperated Astarion watches his sister Violet flirt with a harvester devil
The manager of Rat's Run, Lief Cloudswell, makes it known that the tavern is a refuge for sailors and scoundrels alike
When magic is involved, a hero's journey can take infinite paths.
A seasoned mage teaches apprentices about illusions.
In highly magical worlds, people use magic for major tasks such as construction.
Mages engage in a magical duel while members of the Crucible Keepers look on.
A retired adventurer shows his grandchild the artifact he found long ago in a dragon's lair: {@item Queen Ehlissa's Marvelous Nightingale|AU}.
A baelnorn gifts a brass dragon a scroll containing ancient magical knowledge.
The Artificers of Eberron are responsible for many amazing inventions, but none more miraculous than the Warforged
An Artificer and his creation meet each other for the first time
Adventurers bring a mysterious artifact recovered from Xen'drik back to their mobile Bastion aboard a Lyrandar sailing ship
A Battle Smith inquisitive trails his quarry through the streets and towers of Sharn
Members of different dragonmarked houses set aside their differences to investigate a murder in Sharn, the City of Towers.
An Armorer Explorer ventures into an ancient ruin in Xen'drik in search of magical secrets
Conflict between houses escalates to the skies as elemental airships join in battle
"I am he who rules the world, don't you know? One little piece at a time."–Jarlaxle
Alias and her loyal friend Dragonbait defeated Moander long ago, but not forever.
Sheriff Markham and Drizzt know better than to go face to face with the horror that is Zlan
Deryan Kaya leads Artemis Entreri in an escape from an efreeti of the Calim Desert.
Princess Caitlyn Kendrick sails her Windskiff through magical Moonshae Isles
Karlach Cliffgate enjoys herself on the streets of Baldur's Gate
Chapter 7: The Lost Library of Lethchauntos
Laeral Silverhand was the first victim of Myrkul's Crown of Horns
Xanathar—along with Sylgar, Ott Steeltoes, and the mind flayer Nihiloor—are only some of the many dangers adventurers encounter in the Forgotten Realms.
Heroes in Faerûn come from all species, all character classes, and all walks of life. But they have one thing in common: their epic nature.
Chapter 2: A Guide to the Realms
Presto, Diana, and Eric battle Themberchaud where he lairs in the duergar city of Gracklstugh
Minsc, Boo, and Delina explore the ruins of Myth Drannor.
Selûne the Moonmaiden, and Shar, Mistress of the Night, are sisters and divine rivals.
Vajra Safahr commands the mighty walking statues of Waterdeep.
Areas can shift between the bounds of Lorwyn and Shadowmoor with little warning
A Lorwyn boggart plays near an eclipsed realm
Settlements in Lorwyn are often idyllic and peaceful, like this kithkin clachan
Residents of a Low Netherese settlement gaze upon the spectacular sight of a flying city
Flying cities are the breathtaking pinnacle of Netherese magic and excess
The rampant magical experimentation in Netheril often caused strange environmental effects
Passing through a time gate is a dramatic experience
The cosmos-shaking magic of Karsus's Folly drives a caldron magen into a violent frenzy
The Weathermay-Foxgrove Twins, Gennifer and Laurie, along with Savra Sunstar and Ez d'Avenir, explore the infamous House on Gryphon Hill
By the light of the full moon, villagers in Kartakass undergo a terrifying transformation
Alanik Ray and Arthur Sedgwick investigate the occult art collection of the Marquis Stezen d'Polarno
A hexblood witch in the domain of Tepest conjures visions of adventurers' fatal fates
A grim dullahan strikes down its victim, claiming another grisly death's head as a follower
